title: Extrapolation of max-stable random fields with Fréchet marginals
summary: We propose a method for the prediction of stationary max--stable random fields with $α$-Fréchet marginal distribution $H_α$. The method is suitable to cope with heavy tails for $α\in(0,2)$ and is (approximately) exact in marginal distributions. It is based on a recent extrapolation approach via level sets which requires no moment assumptions. An explicit connection between the excursion metric and the Davis-Resnick distance is established.
